data.title: 妮芙 · 审讯室暗镜后的惑心低语
data.action: 倒坐在转椅上，下巴搁在椅背顶端，萨卡兹小角在红发间微耸，修长指节托着下巴，眼神充满看穿心绪的狡黠。
data.location: 罗德岛深层心理观测室，单向玻璃反射出幽暗暖黄的台灯光泽
data.lighting: 桌底向上投射的单点暖黄光源，在萨卡兹小角与下颌间形成深邃的戏剧性阴影
data.mood: 小恶魔般的戏谑探究，掌控心理防线的危险刺激感
data.description: 罗德岛深层心理观测室，单向玻璃反射出幽暗暖黄的台灯光泽。倒坐在转椅上，下巴搁在椅背顶端，萨卡兹小角在红发间微耸，修长指节托着下巴，眼神充满看穿心绪的狡黠。 她微微抬眸轻语——“你的恐惧、心跳还有欲望……在我的视野里就像写在脸上的密文一样清晰哦。不用装傻啦，博士。”
data.promptProse: Nymph sits backwards on a swivel chair inside a dimly lit counseling observation room at night, resting her chin atop her fingers along the chair back with a teasing, perceptive smirk. Wearing a deep wine-red velvet strappy bralette with miniature rose-gold buckles and black fishnet panels, she is dramatically lit from below by a single warm desk lamp.
data.animaCaption: Sitting backwards in a swivel chair with her chin propped over the chair back in a wine-red velvet and black fishnet strappy bralette, she watches the viewer with a sharp, impish smirk. Warm uplighting from a low desk lamp glints off the dark observation mirror behind her.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a deep wine-red velvet strappy bralette set accented with tiny rose-gold buckles and black fishnet insets.
